Abebook.title: The Arts of Love: Five Studies in the Discourse of Roman Love Elegy
Abebook.subject: classics; Latin literature; Roman love elegy; Ovid; Propertius; Tibullus; literary theory; literary criticism; Roman Literature and its Contexts; Duncan F. Kennedy; Barthes; Foucault; Paul Veyne; elegiac poetry; gender studies
Abebook.description: First edition, first printing, in the Cambridge series Roman Literature and its Contexts; five studies reading Tibullus, Propertius and Ovid through Veyne, Barthes and Foucault, with all Latin translated or closely paraphrased. Trade paperback in the series' black and green laminated wrappers; no dust jacket, as issued. Very good: slight wear to the covers, with light scuffing and surface scratches to the glossy black laminate and a faint crease along the front joint; one page carries a light grey discoloration. The text is clean and unmarked throughout and the binding is tight and square.
